**What problem would this solve?**
What are you trying to do that CachePanel doesn't support today?

**What would the feature look like?**
Rough sketch is fine — a new dashboard card, a settings toggle, a new endpoint, etc.

**Which part of CachePanel does this touch?**
- [ ] Dashboard / stats
- [ ] Steam / Battle.net / Epic prefill
- [ ] Scheduling
- [ ] Notifications (Discord)
- [ ] Diagnostics / cache health
- [ ] Deployment (Docker / Unraid / TrueNAS)
- [ ] Something else

**Anything else?**
Links to prior art, screenshots from other tools, etc. are welcome.
